title: BitMine Goes on ‘$827M Aggressive’ ETH Buying Spree After Crypto Market Crash
summary: BitMine has increased its ETH reserves with a $827M purchase during the sell-off, adding 202,037 tokens for a total of 3,032,188—about 2.5% of circulating supply. Chairman Tom Lee says Ethereum has entered a “supercycle” driven by AI and financial integration.
